liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Greeting**: rare: 11 archived performances [9]
- **Rosa Lee McFall**: rare: 11 archived performances [9]
- **My Love Come Rolling Down**: back after 94 archived shows (793 days) [9]
- **A Good Woman’s Love**: rare: 13 archived performances [9]
- **Freeborn Man**: back after 55 archived shows (617 days) [9]
- **Cassidy**: rare: 7 archived performances [9]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Heartbeat Of America [9]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2021-09-25.mbho** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 183 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording is clear, with very little background chatter [8]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.dpa4011**: source not stated; 29 songs; 184 min [2]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.Renewal_NeumannTLM102_AT897**: source not stated; 28 songs; 189 min [4]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.Renewal_NeumannTLM102**: source not stated; 28 songs; 186 min [5]

## Around the show

- Tyler Grant joined on guitar and vocals during the show [1]
- Tyler Grant guested on guitar and vocals [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2021-09-25.mbho**: taped by Rob O'Brien; transferred by Rob O'Brien; source: MBHO KA500 HN(DIN) > MBP 603 A > Sound Devices MixPre-6 II(24/96) [1]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.dpa4011**: taped by Rob O'Brien; transferred by Rob O'Brien; source: DPA 4011(DIN) > Sound Devices MixPre-6 II(24/96) [2]. Also: Recorded with DPA 4011 mics into a Sound Devices MixPre-6 II at 24/96, taped front of board, 80 feet from stage [2]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.Renewal_NeumannTLM102_AT897**: taped by CorFit Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: Neumann TLM102 + AT 897 > SD MixPre-10ii [4]
- **billystrings2021-09-25.Renewal_NeumannTLM102**: taped by CorFit Chris; transferred by InsideOut Recording; source: Neumann TLM 102 > SD MixPre-10ii [5]. Also: Recorded with Neumann TLM 102 mics into a Sound Devices MixPre-10ii, 75 feet from stage, 9 feet high; processed by CorFit Chris at InsideOut Recording [5]
